method.features: Measure mean, median, spread and positive share of loss reduction with the topic cue. Center the mean against the other interior sentences. One head uses these changes. A second adds baseline ratio, observed loss, reference cross-entropy, and native context classifier response.
method.points: Use each genuine calibration document's highest eligible ratio-only response. Freeze a point allowing half of eligible calibration documents and one allowing one third. No public probability.
method.screen: Keep every natively supporting classifier window. Admit new ratio-only locations only where the ratio already supports the exact sentence and a learned response exceeds a frozen genuine-only point. Edges and incomplete response pairs supply no independent ratio-only location.
method.sources: Reuse the 48 known government-report work groups for development and calibration. Use 24 new works per held generator. Exclude recorded works and overlapping normalized 12-word phrases.
method.windows: Read each exact interior sentence with a six-term cue built from the other four sentences. A neutral cue has exactly the same token count. Measure loss changes on identical non-cue target tokens with the existing base model.
